items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: living on his level was Hall Overton, a pianist and arranger. And they had a nice piano there. And I used to go there to make a lot of sessions.

ctx.x: How did you find out about the jam sessions, just word of mouth? Or were there certain places that they happened all the time?

Oh yeah, there was the loft on 34th Street, there was the loft on Sixth Avenue in the 30s, those were the two main ones I went to. There were others down in the Bowery district. One of the lofts I went to a lot belonged to the famous photographer W. Eugene Smith. Have you ever seen his name around? He’s a photographer, a journalist photographer who is now deceased but he was a very prominent Life magazine photographer along with like Capra and those others. And this was his loft. And in fact I think he had two…
So going back to this union thing, they would put bands together for certain occasions?
